problem_text:
A shipping company must allocate cargo space across six distinct freight categories, each necessitating sequential handling through six specialized logistical stages.  
The revenue generated per ton of freight for each category is listed below:  
* Category Alpha yields 18.636 per ton  
* Category Beta yields 14.383 per ton  
* Category Gamma yields 9.306 per ton  
* Category Delta yields 5.552 per ton  
* Category Epsilon yields 10.65 per ton  
* Category Zeta yields 7.353 per ton  

The handling duration required per ton for every logistical stage is as follows:  
* For Category Alpha, Stage 1 consumes 1.187 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.464 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.514 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.858 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.352 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.637 (ton-hours)  
* For Category Beta, Stage 1 consumes 1.782 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.324 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.902 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.069 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.798 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.421 (ton-hours)  
* For Category Gamma, Stage 1 consumes 0.28 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.633 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.707 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.506 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.629 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.607 (ton-hours)  
* For Category Delta, Stage 1 consumes 1.781 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.033 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 1.778 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 0.448 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 1.217 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.224 (ton-hours)  
* For Category Epsilon, Stage 1 consumes 1.875 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 0.21 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.902 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.643 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 2.0 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 0.235 (ton-hours)  
* For Category Zeta, Stage 1 consumes 1.683 (ton-hours), Stage 2 consumes 1.118 (ton-hours), Stage 3 consumes 0.269 (ton-hours), Stage 4 consumes 1.599 (ton-hours), Stage 5 consumes 0.401 (ton-hours), Stage 6 consumes 1.301 (ton-hours)  

The cumulative handling duration for each logistical stage is bounded by available capacity:  
* Stage 1 cannot exceed 307.608 ton-hours  
* Stage 2 cannot exceed 119.167 ton-hours  
* Stage 3 cannot exceed 210.333 ton-hours  
* Stage 4 cannot exceed 298.233 ton-hours  
* Stage 5 cannot exceed 256.747 ton-hours  
* Stage 6 cannot exceed 125.752 ton-hours  

Under the stipulation that the total processing time for every individual stage—Stage 1 through Stage 6—must remain within its respective allocated capacity, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each freight category so as to maximize overall revenue.
